captions.detailed: A specialty perspective-control camera lens consisting of a rear base barrel, a middle tilt-and-shift mechanism, and a front lens block. The rear base and front blocks are finished in matte black with dark grey lens caps at each end. In the center, two parallel grey cylindrical rails guide the shift sliding stage, while a central hinge assembly enables tilt adjustments, locked by two small ribbed grey knobs on short side shafts.
captions.instruction: Generate a technical model of a perspective-control camera lens. The model must feature a rear mounting barrel, a front lens block, a central tilt hinge, a prismatic shift rail assembly, and two side-mounted lock knobs with continuous rotation.
captions.factory: The object is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. The rear base is formed by combining a cylinder and a rectangular box primitive. The shift rail is modeled as two parallel cylinders. The front block is built from a square plate with concentric cylinders representing the lens barrel. Two lock knobs are modeled as cylinders with small rectangular ribs pattern-rotated around their outer faces. Prismatic, revolute, and continuous joints are defined to articulate the shift stage, tilt hinge, and lock knobs, respectively.
